title: Guard Core: Quadratic ReDoS in built-in detection pattern freezes the event loop with a single request (CVE-2026-129302)
description: A quadratic regular-expression denial of service (ReDoS) vulnerability exists in guard-core's built-in template-injection detection pattern starting from version 3.5.0 up to but not including 3.13.0. This flaw allows unauthenticated remote clients to freeze the asyncio event loop of applications embedding guard-core by sending specially crafted requests containing repeated '{' characters. The vulnerable pattern executes without timeout protection, causing the event loop to block for seconds per request without triggering detection or rate limiting. This regression was introduced in version 3.5.0, undoing previous protections. The issue is fixed in version 3.13.0.
